channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Command Block Client Extension
item.description: Enables client commands in the Command Blocks (+ some utilities!)

item.title: Antler Util
item.description: Helps you collecting antlers (also would work as a workaround for the "phantom" shed antlers issue)

item.title: Scoop of Jam

item.title: Simple Blobcat
item.description: Adds a simple companion blobcat

item.description: Disables "Screenshot ***.png taken." chat message (No server install needed)

item.description: Adds a simple alarm timer command `.tm` (No server install needed)

item.title: Egg Pie (Quiche)
item.description: Allows eggs in pies

item.title: Self-Recording Thermometer
item.description: Adds a self-recording thermometer

item.description: Allows beam ends to overlap reliably (+ some fixes)

item.description: Take notes and track tasks in-world. Pin tasks to a persistent HUD. Multiplayer-ready.

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: Age of Seraphs Tweaks
item.description: Tweaks for the Age of Seraphs server that were too small to make into their own mods

item.description: Maple wood retexture

item.description: A planet-based world generation pipeline.

item.title: Windlass
item.description: Elevator

item.title: Liber Terra
item.description: Pre-1300 CE public-domain literature as lore books, pile & stack books,oh and books are weapons now.

item.title: Emotes
item.description: Adds more custom emotes to the game.

item.title: Cycle of Life: RealFauna Pack
item.description: A realistic overlay pack for Cycle of Life.

item.description: A realistic simulated fauna ecosystem.
